scientific_integrity: Analytical proof; finite checker is diagnostic only. Reuses classical harmonic representation and published qualitative convergence, and credits the prior supergeometric case. The novel claim is the complete sharp odd-order hierarchy and constructive realization. No independent verification or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Centered means on strictly positive two-periodic bilateral weighted shifts. The exact asymptotic for arbitrary nonsymmetric means excludes initial data producing finite equality; all constructed Legendre examples avoid it. Higher periods and noncommuting weights are not treated.
title: Every odd superattraction order for centered induced mean transforms of period-two shifts
